items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Lacey was a much better drummer than my brother. I admire him. I admire him.

ctx.x: Oh, different ones he played with or anything else about his style of playing? Because that fellow never recorded and nobody knows anything about him much either. Like Lacey, I wondered what style they played. Did you tell anything more about the type of drums and all they played?

Well, I would say my kid brother plays something on her Lacey. He plays smooth, you know what I mean? He's not rough at all. Lacey was a much better drummer than my brother. I admire him. I admire him. All the old timers and all the drummers are. Still to say I'll take Mac Lacey.
